cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've crossed Saturday on the hall calendar like you. Let's leave it marked while we consider the festival bid.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My cross means unavailable. You've blocked the hall, not booked it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, keeping it from anyone else. Leave it blocked until we've talked to the committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One day. I'll tell them the hold expires tomorrow unless we submit a bid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them our festival has a one-day hold. Once they expect a bid tomorrow, we can spend tonight finishing it.

reason: Create a specific misunderstood copied action which determines how A pursues this Drive, preserving useful seed causality and giving B a concrete concern that changes the ending.
